nodes.description: Mapping _onSaleNum tracks how many times an address has sold; incremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Mapping canSale marks addresses whitelisted to bypass the sale condition in ensure().
Minimum sale amount threshold read by condition().
Maximum sale amount threshold read by condition().
Number of allowed sales per address read by condition().
Whitelisted trade address settable by owner via setTradeAddress and trusted in ensure().
Public balance mapping mutated with raw arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public allowance mapping written in approve and decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Constant decimals (18) used to scale supply and sale thresholds.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Token name string.
Token symbol string.
Privileged owner address that gates delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress and can bypass ensure().
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address constant trusted by ensure().
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist check: owner/tradeAddress/UNI/pair or canSale bypasses, otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance and balance checks and unchecked balance mutations.
Public payable approve that unconditionally overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing sale-count, min and max sale thresholds.
Owner-only function performing a.delegatecall(b) to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only initializer that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum using raw multiplication.
Owner-only batch send that subtracts total from the owner balance unchecked and loops distributing value.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure().
Payable constructor assigning name, symbol, supply, owner and an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
msg.sender: caller address used as authorization subject and allowance owner across the contract.
Arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata executed in the contract's storage context.
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance decrement, balance subtraction/addition and _onSaleNum increment.
Unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance subtractions/additions.
transferFrom parameter _from: source address whose allowance and balance are checked and debited.
transferFrom parameter _to: destination address whose balance is credited unchecked.
transferFrom parameter _value: amount transferred, compared against allowance and balance.
delegate parameter a: arbitrary target address supplied by the owner for delegatecall.
delegate parameter b: arbitrary calldata executed through delegatecall.
batchSend parameter _tos: array of recipient addresses driving the distribution loop.
batchSend parameter _value: per-recipient amount multiplied by _tos.length without SafeMath.
setTradeAddress parameter addr: new whitelisted trade address stored by the owner.
Local _UNI in ensure(): pair address for factory/WETH/this token used in the whitelist check.
Local total in batchSend(): _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked multiplication.
Local loop counter i in batchSend().

edges.reason: transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument into transferFrom.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key for the allowance check and decrement.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller as the owner.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing an arbitrary delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale thresholds.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before overwriting tradeAddress.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the caller.
ensure() short-circuits the sale condition when _from or _to equals owner, granting a privileged bypass.
owner state variable guards the delegate entry point.
owner state variable guards the init entry point.
owner state variable guards the batchSend entry point.
owner state variable guards the setTradeAddress entry point.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() falls back to require(condition(_from, _value)) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() calls pairFor to derive the trusted pair address _UNI.
transferFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] for the spender authorization check.
approve writes the allowance mapping for the caller and spender.
approve stores _value into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transferFrom checks and mutates balanceOf for _from and _to.
batchSend checks and mutates balanceOf for the owner and each recipient.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every sale.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] as an unconditional whitelist bypass.
condition() compares _value against _minSale.
condition() compares _value against _maxSale.
condition() reads _saleNum as the per-address sale cap.
ensure() trusts tradeAddress as a whitelisted sender.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
Constructor initializes totalSupply from _supply scaled by decimals.
init scales _minSale and _maxSale by 10**decimals.
Constructor scales supply by 10**decimals.
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b), an unsafe arbitrary delegatecall under owner control.
The delegatecall target address comes directly from user-supplied parameter a.
The delegatecall calldata comes directly from user-supplied parameter b.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic that can underflow or overflow.
Parameter _value feeds the unchecked allowance/balance subtractions and additions.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is executed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are executed without SafeMath.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ is an unchecked increment.
batchSend computes total and mutates balances with raw unchecked arithmetic.
Parameter _value is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow protection.
Parameter _tos defines the loop bound and therefore the multiplication factor for total.
Local total = _value * _tos.length is computed unchecked before the balance debit.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and balanceOf[_to] += _value are unchecked.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the debit source of transferFrom.
_to is only meaningful as the credit target of transferFrom.
_value directly feeds the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Parameter a is the arbitrary target of the unsafe delegatecall.
Parameter b is the arbitrary calldata of the unsafe delegatecall.
_tos determines the loop and the unchecked total multiplication in batchSend.
_value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total and of the balance credits.
addr is written directly into tradeAddress by the owner-only setter.
_UNI is a computed whitelist value used only inside ensure().
total is the unchecked product consumed by the batchSend debit.
i is the loop counter of the unchecked batchSend distribution loop.
